answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy works best when identity is a bonded position, not a free account. An agent must stake real value into a vault before it can vote or be paid, and peers release its nectar of rewards only after independently attesting that its work matches its claims. Each submission is also salted with a fresh crystal of per-epoch randomness, so replies cannot be recycled across clones. Cost to an attacker: every fake identity needs its own stake, its own attested history, and its own compute time, all forfeitable the moment peers detect collusion.
